labels.justification: The clause mentions data security measures like encryption and pattern recognition, but lacks specific details on implementing security safeguards as required.
The clause discusses data usage across services but lacks explicit mention of processing data only for the specified purpose as required.
The clause describes data sharing but lacks explicit mention of protecting personal data against unauthorized processing as required.
The clause mentions consent management but lacks explicit mention of registering a Consent Manager with the Data Protection Board of India as required.
The clause describes access to personal data but lacks explicit mention of the right to request access as required.
The clause does not meaningfully address any listed requirement.
